title: Detailed yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="g1" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b35"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#e63946"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b71c1c"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="g2" cx="40%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffab00"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="g3" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4dd0e1"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#0288d1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#01579b"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="g4" cx="45%" cy="40%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e0e0e0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- String -->
  <path d="M50 5 L50 38" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="4" r="3.5" fill="#e0e0e0"/>

  <!-- Left half body -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="60" rx="22" ry="24" fill="url(#g1)"/>
  <!-- Left half rim -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="60" rx="22" ry="24" fill="none" stroke="#ff8a65" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- Left inner disc -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="60" rx="16" ry="18" fill="url(#g2)" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- Left inner ring detail -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="60" rx="10" ry="11" fill="none" stroke="#ff6f00" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Right half body -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="60" rx="22" ry="24" fill="url(#g1)"/>
  <!-- Right half rim -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="60" rx="22" ry="24" fill="none" stroke="#ff8a65" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- Right inner disc -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="60" rx="16" ry="18" fill="url(#g2)" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- Right inner ring detail -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="60" rx="10" ry="11" fill="none" stroke="#ff6f00" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Center axle gap highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="5" ry="18" fill="#b71c1c" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Axle peg -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="6" fill="url(#g3)"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="3" fill="url(#g4)"/>

  <!-- Sparkle highlights on left -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="50" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35" transform="rotate(-20 28 50)"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="48" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5" transform="rotate(-20 30 48)"/>

  <!-- Sparkle highlights on right -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="50" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35" transform="rotate(20 72 50)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="48" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5" transform="rotate(20 70 48)"/>

  <!-- Side rim shine left -->
  <path d="M18 52 Q20 46 25 44" stroke="#ffccbc" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Side rim shine right -->
  <path d="M82 52 Q80 46 75 44" stroke="#ffccbc" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Bottom rim shine left -->
  <path d="M22 70 Q26 76 33 78" stroke="#ffab91" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Bottom rim shine right -->
  <path d="M78 70 Q74 76 67 78" stroke="#ffab91" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Spiral groove details on left -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="60" rx="19" ry="21" fill="none" stroke="#ff7043" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.4" stroke-dasharray="3 4"/>
  <!-- Spiral groove details on right -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="60" rx="19" ry="21" fill="none" stroke="#ff7043" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.4" stroke-dasharray="3 4"/>

  <!-- String loop at top -->
  <path d="M50 38 Q44 42 46 46 Q48 50 50 48 Q52 50 54 46 Q56 42 50 38" fill="none" stroke="#b0bec5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
</svg>
